stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def solve(Aa, bgv):
    ptr = pointer(Aa)  # largest unique-color L
    cells, col = ptr
    cr = min(r for r,c in cells); cc = min(c for r,c in cells)  # bend = topmost-leftmost? use actual corner
    # get true bend: cell with two arm directions
    s=set(cells)
    cr,cc = is_L(Aa[ptr[0] and 0:1] ) if False else (None,None)
    return None
# simpler: find bend = cell in pointer whose neighbors exist in 2 perpendicular dirs
def bend(cells):
    s=set(cells)
    for (r,c) in s:
        up=(r-1,c) in s; down=(r+1,c) in s; left=(r,c-1) in s; right=(r,c+1) in s
        if (up or down) and (left or right): return (r,c)
    return None
def run(Aa,bgv):
    ptrs=[(col2,o) for col2 in set(Aa.flatten()) if col2!=bgv for o in objs(Aa,col2) if is_L(o)[0]]
    # unique-color Ls only
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(Aa.flatten())
    ptrs=[(col2,o) for col2,o in ptrs if cnt[col2]==len(o)]
    pcol,pcells=max(ptrs,key=lambda t:len(t[1]))
    br,bc=bend(pcells)
    bgcol=set(np.unique(Aa))  # bg value
    best=None
    for col2 in set(Aa.flatten()):
        if col2==bgv or col2==pcol: continue
        for o in objs(Aa,col2):
            if is_L(o)[0]: continue
            d=min((abs(r-br)+abs(c-bc),r,c) for r,c in o if r<=br and c>bc)
            if d and (best is None or d<best[0]): best=(d,col2,o)
    return (pcol,(br,bc),best)

def parse(s):
    return [[int(x) for x in r.split()] for r in s.strip().split('\n')]

def shapes(g, bg):
    R,C=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=set(); out=[]
    for r in range(R):
        for c in range(C):
            if g[r][c]!=bg and (r,c) not in seen:
                col=g[r][c]; q=deque([(r,c)]); seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
                while q:
                    x,y=q.popleft(); cells.append((x,y))
                    for dx,dy in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        nx,ny=x+dx,y+dy
                        if 0<=nx<R and 0<=ny<C and g[nx][ny]==col and (nx,ny) not in seen:
                            seen.add((nx,ny)); q.append((nx,ny))
                out.append((col,cells))
    return out

def sil(cells):
    rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
    r0,c0=min(rs),min(cs)
    return frozenset((r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in cells)

    for s,v in sorted(bysil.items(), key=lambda kv:-kv[1][0][4]):
